main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x (18-bar return minus coin's normal 18-bar drift)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with ordinary t >= 2.0 and quintile difference > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2.0

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of top forecast quintile minus bottom quintile

decided_by: The main mean is positive with t >= 2.0 and the quintile difference is above 0.
reading: Grid cells are positions 0,18,36,... of each window with t+18 inside the window, the coin's drift is the mean of those grid returns over all its windows, quintiles are pooled over all cases by forecast rank, and the plan's 500-case minimum is applied as 'not observable'.
